title: Run the environment setup on a temporary clean local account and write the report
goal: kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md records one run on a temporary local standard account on the Windows 11 host (Git for Windows machine-wide, no Python for that account): install-python.ps1's preflight and install output, then every /kb-setup step that needs no Claude Code sign-in, run by its command as that account (python3 version, check.py, fetch.py --offline, stress_test.py, tests.py, rag.py eval, rag.py pack, kbgit.py install-hooks), each with its exit code and last line, what was not run and why (the sign-in, MCP registration and calls, the query log question), placeholders for host and user names, and a final line result: pass only if every step run passed; the account is deleted afterwards.

run: import pathlib,re;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert re.search(r'(?m)^result: pass$',t);assert not re.search(r'(?i)<host and user name pieces removed by BG-477tasb3>', t)
